北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友注意，今日有雾，体感 33℃，出门小心，注意防晒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing, foggy with a feels-like 33℃. Stay safe and protect yourself from the sun!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阴天 31℃，体感 35℃。闷热难耐，注意防暑补水！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, 31℃ feels like 35℃. It's hot and muggy, take measures to prevent heatstroke and hydrate!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云 31℃，体感 32℃，湿度 60%，出门带伞，防晒也别忘！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai, 31℃, feels like 32℃ with 60% humidity. Take an umbrella and don't forget sun protection!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阵雨，体感 32℃，湿度 81%，出门记得带伞，小心路滑。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou, showers and feels like 32℃, 81% humidity. Carry an umbrella and watch your step!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 30℃，体感 33℃，湿度 80%，风力 4级，注意防潮哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 30℃ feels like 33℃ with 80% humidity and level 4 winds. Mind the dampness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天 30℃，体感 33℃，风力 4级。天热易疲惫，午后小憩一下吧。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, 30℃ feels like 33℃ with level 4 winds. Hot days are tiring, take a nap if you can!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 36℃，风力 5级。天气炎热，注意补水防晒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing, sunny and feels like 36℃ with level 5 winds. It's scorching, hydrate and protect from sun!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴天，体感高达 39℃！小心酷暑，多喝水，少出门！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu, sunny and feels like a staggering 39℃! Beware of extreme heat, drink lots of water, stay indoors!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云 34℃，体感 35℃。今日高温，请注意防暑降温！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan, cloudy 34℃ feels like 35℃. High temperatures today, please take heatstroke prevention measures!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴空万里，体感 36℃！记得多喝水，防晒别偷懒哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an, clear skies and feels like 36℃! Remember to hydrate and don't skip sun protection.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 36℃，体感 37℃，湿度 44%。今天特别热，注意防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing, 36℃ feels like 37℃ with 44% humidity. It's extremely hot, take care to prevent heatstroke!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云 26℃，体感 27℃，风力 5级。风大，注意添衣别着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin, cloudy 26℃ feels like 27℃ with level 5 winds. It's windy, wear extra layers to avoid catching a cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云 28℃，体感 29℃。湿度高，风力 4级，多喝水哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang, cloudy 28℃ feels like 29℃ with high humidity and level 4 winds. Drink plenty of water!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 24℃，体感 26℃，体感舒适。享受这好天气吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming, cloudy 24℃ feels like 26℃, comfortable. Enjoy the lovely weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门小雨，体感 28℃，湿度 99%。出门带伞，小心湿滑！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen, light rain and feels like 28℃, 99% humidity. Take an umbrella and watch out for slippery surfaces!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云 30℃，体感 31℃，湿度 80%。风力 4级，小心吹感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao, cloudy 30℃ feels like 31℃, 80% humidity, level 4 winds. Beware of catching a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云 27℃，体感 30℃，湿度 81%。空气潮湿，注意除湿。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian, cloudy 27℃ feels like 30℃, 81% humidity. Air is humid, consider dehumidifying.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天 29℃，体感 31℃，湿度 83%。天闷，注意通风降温。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy, 29℃ feels like 31℃, 83% humidity. It's stuffy, ventilate and cool down.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 35℃，多云天也很热，别忘了多喝水，小心中暑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 35℃, even cloudy it's hot. Remember to drink water and avoid heatstroke!
